reason: The initial full-identity text had weak cross-language recall. A four-input development diagnostic found similar FP32/INT8 vectors and language/boilerplate sensitivity. Task-only text and standard diversity selection are a new candidate, not a relabeling of the initial observation.
pooling: attention-mask mean followed by L2 normalization
constraints: Retained by the immutable lexical snapshot and deterministic review; never inferred from vector similarity.
fusion: Exact identities first, then equal round-robin union of MMR dense and lexical ranks with stable ID de-duplication.
diversityScope: Standard maximal marginal relevance across the bounded in-memory corpus, not a truncated top-score pool. No source records are merged or deleted.
pairEvaluation: All 140 frozen left queries against all 140 frozen right records; exact paired-target recall and unresolved pair decisions reported separately.
selectionPolicy: No further tuning from this run. Report both splits; designated held-out domains have already been exposed to the initial experiment and are not a blind confirmation set.
externalCalls: Public model/dependency downloads only; local embeddings and zero paid LLM calls.
limitations: Authored synthetic data, repeated distractors and shared-host measurements; no natural-language error rate, market result or independent user acceptance.
